label: My return: the tax of an earlier year - slabs, special rates, 87A, surcharge with marginal relief, cess

params.name: resident
params.label: resident that year (the unused basic exemption against special-rate gains, 87A)

params.name: ltcg_112
params.label: long-term gains u/s 112 (after indexation when that year's 112 had it)

params.name: early
params.label: FY 2024-25: the gains were on transfers before 23 July 2024

description_nl: 2026-10-08: An earlier year's tax as that year's Finance Act had it (chip myreturn.year_rates): the slabs on normal income; a resident's unused basic exemption against the 111A, then 112A (after its exemption), then 112 gains; the special rates; 87A (a resident with total income within the limit; never against 112A tax, s.112A(6); from FY 2025-26 in the new regime only against slab-rate tax) with the new regime's marginal relief from FY 2023-24; the surcharge on the tax - the 111A / 112A / 112 part at most 15% where that year capped it - with marginal relief (tax and surcharge at most the tax at the line plus the income over it, the excess taken off normal income); the cess on both.
